findings.deletion_test: Deleting the clause would lose the Collector's core capabilities. Preserve those facts; the defect is the grammatical connection between the implementation and its functions.
findings.diagnosis: The construction “implementation on how to” conflates an implementation with instructions, making the opening definition awkward to parse.
findings.evidence: Lines 49–50 define the Collector through its ability to receive, process, and export telemetry data.

findings.deletion_test: The clause usefully introduces the meeting purposes, so preserve it. Correcting agreement loses no information.
findings.diagnosis: The singular verb “serves” disagrees with its plural antecedent, “those calls.”
findings.evidence: Line 68 refers to “those calls,” and lines 70–73 list their purposes.

findings.deletion_test: Removing the topic-interest criterion would weaken the instruction about whom to invite. Preserve the criterion while addressing the preposition error.
findings.diagnosis: “Interested on” uses the wrong preposition for interest in a discussion topic.
findings.evidence: Lines 87–90 ask contributors to invite others to discussions and identify people interested in the topic.

findings.deletion_test: Removing “using” preserves the build relationship and the specified protocol version without losing a technical fact.
findings.diagnosis: “Built against using” combines two competing grammatical constructions, leaving an unnecessary verb between the build relationship and its object.
findings.evidence: Lines 99–100 identify the OTLP version used by the code base and its stability status.

findings.deletion_test: Deleting the reference to tests would lose part of the compatibility policy. Preserve both build and test coverage; the defect is grammatical.
findings.diagnosis: The plural noun “tests” is incorrectly used as a modifier of “steps” in this coordinated phrase.
findings.evidence: Line 115 specifies the build and testing steps added when a new Go minor version is released.

findings.deletion_test: The heading identifies a useful reader task and should remain. Repairing the noun relationship loses no task information.
findings.diagnosis: “Images signatures” lacks the possessive marking needed for the plural noun relationship, making the heading grammatically malformed.
findings.evidence: Lines 125–139 explain how to verify signatures associated with Collector images.
